name: Single-agent CARBOplatin (AUC 7), stage I seminoma adjuvant

biomarkers.AFP: must be normal (a rising AFP excludes pure seminoma)
biomarkers.note: Pure seminoma does not produce AFP; an elevated/rising AFP implies nonseminomatous elements and this adjuvant option would not apply. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - Pure Seminoma.

lineOfTherapy: single-cycle (or two-cycle) adjuvant chemotherapy after orchiectomy for clinical stage IA/IB pure seminoma, as an alternative to surveillance or adjuvant radiotherapy; not line-scoped

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: clinical stage IA or IB pure seminoma after radical orchiectomy
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - Pure Seminoma
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, Pure Seminoma stage IA/IB Primary Treatment page (SEM-1): Single-agent Carboplatin (AUC = 7 x 1 cycle or AUC = 7 x 2 cycles)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: discuss sperm banking prior to chemotherapy

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - Pure Seminoma
provenance.locator: Pure Seminoma stage IA/IB Primary Treatment page (SEM-1): Single-agent Carboplatin (area under the curve [AUC] = 7 x 1 cycle or AUC = 7 x 2 cycles)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Pure Seminoma SEM-1. CARBOplatin dosed to target AUC 7 (Calvert formula, not mg/m2), day 1 of each cycle. Given as 1 cycle (single-dose) or 2 cycles. Discussion corroborates AUC x 7 (per the formula 7 x [GFR + 25]). Tall-man per ISMP. Limited long-term toxicity/efficacy follow-up for carboplatin in this setting (NCCN footnote l).

regimen.cycles: 1 (single-dose adjuvant) or 2 cycles, each at AUC 7

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: CARBOplatin AUC 7 is moderately-to-highly emetogenic; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier. Confirm exact institutional/guideline tier.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: prophylaxis per CARBOplatin emetogenicity tier.
AUC dosing: compute CARBOplatin dose by the Calvert formula from measured/estimated GFR; verify renal function before dosing.
G-CSF: not indicated for single-agent adjuvant carboplatin.

monitoring: Renal function (creatinine/GFR) before dosing - required for AUC (Calvert) calculation
Serum tumor markers and imaging surveillance per follow-up schedule
clearanceChecks: renal function / GFR for AUC dosing

doseModificationRules.text: Recalculate the AUC-based dose from current GFR (Calvert). Physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: approximately line 167447 (adjuvant single-agent carboplatin for stage I seminoma, AUC 7, one or two cycles, noninferior to radiotherapy)

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - Pure Seminoma
guideline.locator: Pure Seminoma stage IA/IB Primary Treatment page (SEM-1): Single-agent Carboplatin (AUC = 7 x 1 cycle or AUC = 7 x 2 cycles), as an alternative to surveillance (strongly preferred) or radiotherapy

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent adjuvant CARBOplatin in clinical stage IA/IB pure seminoma (#60). Dose from Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - Pure Seminoma v2.2026, stage IA/IB Primary Treatment page (SEM-1): Single-agent CARBOplatin dosed to AUC 7, given as 1 cycle (single dose) or 2 cycles, as an alternative to surveillance (strongly preferred) or adjuvant radiotherapy after orchiectomy. Corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. (approximately line 167447, adjuvant carboplatin AUC 7, one or two cycles, noninferior to radiotherapy); the AUC-7 Calvert formula (7 x [GFR + 25]) is stated by the Standard Guidelines (NCCN) SEM-1, not DeVita. CARBOplatin uses AUC (Calvert) dosing, so renal function must be verified before dosing; there is no lifetime cumulative cap. Applies only to pure seminoma (AFP must be normal). ISMP tall-man applied (CARBOplatin). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
